name: SharedWorkspaceTask
description: The SharedWorkspaceTask object represents a task in a shared document workspace. Member of the SharedWorkspaceTasks collection.
remarks: Use the SharedWorkspaceTask object to manage tasks assigned to the members who are collaborating on the documents in the shared workspace. Use the Item (_index_) property of the SharedWorkspaceTasks collection to return a specific SharedWorkspaceTask object. Use the Title property to set the text of the task that appears on the Tasks tab of the Shared Workspace task pane and on the shared workspace webpage. Use the Description property to supply additional information about the task. Assign the task to a member of the workspace by using the AssignedTo property and the member's domain user name. Specify a due date for the task by using the DueDate property. Use the enumerations for task Priority and Status to indicate the relative importance of the task and to update the task's status. Use the Save method to upload changes to the server after you modify properties of the SharedWorkspaceTask object. Use the CreatedBy, CreatedDate, ModifiedBy, and ModifiedDate properties to return information about the history of each task.
example:
Dim swsTask As Office.SharedWorkspaceTask
    Dim strTaskInfo As String
    strTaskInfo = "The shared workspace contains " & _
    ActiveWorkbook.SharedWorkspace.Tasks.Count & " Task(s)." & vbCrLf
    For Each swsTask In ActiveWorkbook.SharedWorkspace.Tasks
        strTaskInfo = strTaskInfo & swsTask.Title & vbCrLf & _
            " - Description: " & swsTask.Description & vbCrLf & _
            " - Assigned to: " & swsTask.AssignedTo & vbCrLf & _
            " - Due date: " & swsTask.DueDate & vbCrLf & _
            " - Priority: " & swsTask.Priority & vbCrLf & _
            " - Status: " & swsTask.Status & vbCrLf
    Next
    MsgBox strTaskInfo, vbInformation + vbOKOnly, _
        "Tasks in Shared Workspace"
    Set swsTask = Nothing

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SharedWorkspaceTask object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SharedWorkspaceTask object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Sets or gets the title of a SharedWorkspaceTask object. Read/write.

properties.name: AssignedTo
properties.description: Gets or sets a value containing the name of the one assigned to the task represented by the SharedWorkspaceTask object. Read/write.

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Gets or sets the status of the specified shared workspace task. Read/write.

properties.name: Priority
properties.description: Gets or sets the status of the specified shared workspace task. Read/write.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Gets or sets a descriptive String value for the specified SharedWorkspaceLink or SharedWorkspaceTask object. Read/write.

properties.name: DueDate
properties.description: Gets or sets the optional due date and time of a SharedWorkspaceTask object. Read/write.

properties.name: CreatedBy
properties.description: Gets the display name of the member who created the shared workspace object. Read-only.

properties.name: CreatedDate
properties.description: Gets the date and time when the shared workspace object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: ModifiedBy
properties.description: Gets the name of the user who last modified the object. Read-only.

properties.name: ModifiedDate
properties.description: Gets the date and time when the SharedWorkspaceTask object was last modified. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the SharedWorkspaceTask object. Read-only.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Uploads changes made programmatically to a shared server.
